channel.title: Perch
channel.description: Updates for Perch, a tiny floating todo list for the Mac.

item.title: Version 0.1.8
item.description:
• Fixed: the iPhone app opened and closed at once when Match System paired a dark theme with Light or a light theme with Dark. It opens again, and follows the system when you come back to it.
  • The shortcut opens the panel with the new todo already in place, and hiding keeps the row until the panel is gone. No jump either way.
  • Settings takes its text and sizes from one place, so the tabs line up the same.
